statements.t: Third quarter net revenue was $368 million, an increase of 6.8% year-over-year and within the Company’s guidance range.
Comparable Delivered Sales (1) increased 2.6% in the third-quarter, within the Company’s guidance range, bringing year-to-date Comparable Delivered Sales (1) to 1.8%.
During the quarter, the Company completed 2 Total Showroom Projects (3) , including 1 relocated Showroom in Charlotte, North Carolina, and 1 renovated Showroom in Atlanta, Georgia.

For 2026, the Company continues to expect to complete approximately 10 to 14 Total Showroom Projects (3) , consisting of 4 to 6 new openings and 6 to 8 relocations, renovations, or expansions, representing Net Unit Growth (4) of mid-single-digits for the year.
The Company is raising its full-year Net revenue and Comparable Delivered Sales (1) outlook, reflecting strength in client demand and momentum in Comparable Written Sales (2) .

The Company is maintaining its full-year Net Income and Adjusted EBITDA outlook, following an increase last quarter, reflecting continued fuel and transportation cost pressures and the strategic investment into expanded marketing initiatives to support future growth.
The Company considers all Showroom projects integral to its long-term growth strategy, with each evaluated based on strategic relevance and expected return on investment.
